title: Splunk Digital Certificates Lack of Encryption
author: Lou Stella, Splunk
description: The following analytic identifies Splunk forwarder connections that are not using TLS encryption. It leverages data from the `splunkd` logs, specifically looking for connections where the `ssl` field is set to "false". This activity is significant because unencrypted connections can expose sensitive data and allow unauthorized access, posing a security risk. If confirmed malicious, an attacker could exploit this vulnerability to download or publish forwarder bundles, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution and further compromise of the environment.
